item.title: Mamdani says Trump agrees to grant visa to mother of Ghanian teen killed in Bronx shooting
item.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says President Donald Trump has agreed to grant a visa to the mother of a 15-year-old immigrant from Ghana who was shot to death earlier this week.

item.title: Rubio says the US government did not facilitate Bolsonaro’s flight to the US
item.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the Trump administration did not help Flávio Bolsonaro leave Brazil after his election defeat.

item.title: Europe's youth return to the streets for another weekend of protests, in photos
item.description: A third weekend of protests in France as youth-led rallies swept Europe. Hundreds of thousands of mostly young protesters took to the streets across France on Saturday in a third consecutive weekend of demonstrations over living costs and education.

item.title: Valkyries and Dream set for first-ever WNBA Finals Game 7 after Atlanta ties series
item.description: WNBA will crown first-time champion as Golden State and Atlanta meet in Game 7. After three cross-country trips and a physical, entertaining best-of-seven series between the Atlanta Dream and Valkyries, the league is about to crown a first-time champion.

item.title: Heavy rains expected to bring flooding risk to already saturated parts of the US Southwest
item.description: The National Weather Service says heavy rains are expected to bring a threat of flash flooding to already saturated areas of the U.S. Southwest.
